### Current Pendo (`@pantoken/pendo`) Architecture

**Location:** [renderers/pendo/](renderers/pendo/)

**Component Source Files** (7 CSS files → 5 cascade layers):
- [src/css/container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css) — Guide layout variants (alert `[data-layout="lightboxBlank"]`, popover `[data-layout="tooltipBlank"]`, survey `._pendo-guide-walkthrough_`)
- [src/css/card.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/card.css) — Shared card shell + row layout
- [src/css/button.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/button.css) — Button variants (primary/secondary/tertiary)
- [src/css/chrome.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/chrome.css) — Backdrop, image, video, divider, close button
- [src/css/text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css) — Typography
- [src/css/inputs.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/inputs.css) — Form controls (textarea, select, radio, NPS)
- [src/css/vars.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/vars.css) — `--pendo-*` aliases + overrides

**Key Selector Patterns:**
- Guide container: `[class*="instui"]` (token scope)
- Alert: `[data-layout="lightboxBlank"]` + variant classes `[class*="instui-info|danger|success|warning"]`
- Popover: `[data-layout="tooltipBlank"]`
- Survey: `._pendo-guide-walkthrough_`
- Buttons: `._pendo-button`, `._pendo-button-primaryButton`, `._pendo-button-secondaryButton`, `._pendo-button-tertiaryButton`, `._pendo-button-custom`
- Close button: `._pendo-close-guide`
- Card container: `._pendo-step-container-styles` (position:relative parent for close button)

### CSS Assembly & Transformation

**Build Pipeline** ([src/build.ts](renderers/pendo/src/build.ts)):

1. **Token layer** — `toCss(byTheme(theme))` scoped to `[class*="instui"]` (from `@pantoken/css`)
2. **Elevation layer** — `elevationCss()` (from `@pantoken/components`)
3. **Component layers** — 5 layers in cascade order
4. **Focus outline layer** — Delegated ring rules + focus-outline token defs (from `@pantoken/components`)

**Plugin chain** (order matters):
1. `addImportant()` — Adds `!important` to non-custom-property declarations (default on)
2. `pruneCustomProps()` — Tree-shakes unused `--instui-*` tokens (default on)
3. `flattenProperty()` — Converts `@property` to plain declarations via `:scope` (default off)
4. `mangleCustomProps()` — Minifies `--instui-*` to base-26 identifiers (default off)
5. `addScope()` — Wraps in `@scope (._pendo-step-container)` (default on)

**Generated Outputs:**
- [generated/embedded.ts](renderers/pendo/generated/embedded.ts) — 7 const strings (buttonCss, cardCss, containerCss, chromeCss, inputsCss, textCss, varsCss) inlined by [scripts/embed.ts](renderers/pendo/scripts/embed.ts)
- [generated/global.css](renderers/pendo/generated/global.css) — Static stylesheet (flatten + mangle enabled); published as `@pantoken/pendo/global.css`

### Layer Ordering

From [src/layers.ts](renderers/pendo/src/layers.ts#L32-L48):

```
LAYER_ORDER = [
  "tokens", "elevation", "container", "card", "text", "chrome", "button", "inputs", "vars",
  "focusOutline"  // Last = lowest !important priority (baseline focus ring)
]
```

### Button Definitions (Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/Close)

**Primary button** (`._ pendo-button-primaryButton`, `._pendo-button-custom`):
- Base: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-{background,border-color,color}`
- Hover: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-hover-{background,border-color,text-color}`
- Active: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-active-{background,border-color,text-color}`
- Disabled: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-disabled-{background-color,border-color,text-color}`

**Secondary button** (`._pendo-button-secondaryButton`):
- Same state structure; uses secondary token names

**Tertiary button** (`._pendo-button-tertiaryButton`):
- Base: transparent background + `--instui-color-stroke-interactive-action-tertiary-base` border + tertiary text color
- Hover/active: apply tertiary background/border/text tokens
- Disabled: transparent background + disabled tokens

**Close button** (`._pendo-close-guide`):
- Absolute-positioned top-end of card (with alert-specific inset overrides)
- Size: `var(--instui-component-base-button-small-height)` aspect-ratio 1:1
- Hover: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-ghost-hover-background`
- Active: `--instui-component-base-button-primary-ghost-active-background`

### Alert-Specific Styling

**Container** ([container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css#L108-L201)):
- Variant tokens (info/danger/success/warning) set `--_alert-color` + `--_alert-icon` on root
- Left sidebar strip: `::before` with `--_alert-color` background, width `var(--pendo-alert-indent)`, clipped by `overflow:hidden`
- Status icon: `::after` masked from `--_alert-icon` (from icon set), centered in sidebar
- Box shadow: `var(--instui-elevation-above)`
- Padding: left side adds `var(--pendo-alert-indent)` to accommodate sidebar
- Close button positioning: alert-specific top/right offsets override defaults

**Selectors for variants:**
- `&` (default) + `&[class*="instui-info"]` → info variant (both map to same `--_alert-color`)
- `&[class*="instui-danger"]` → danger variant
- `&[class*="instui-success"]` → success variant
- `&[class*="instui-warning"]` → warning variant

**Test file:** [tests/build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts)

**Coverage:**
- Layer order presence + composition
- Focus ring delegation (`focusOutline` last layer)
- Scope + `!important` toggles
